# hocrsyngen

hocrsyngen generates deterministic candidate synthetic Hebrew OCR/HTR sample batches. It emits `generation_manifest.json` plus relative JPEG page assets. hocrgen remains the downstream governance, validation, release, and publication toolchain.

## Compact Source Tree

- `src/hocrsyngen/`: Python package.
- `src/hocrsyngen/schemas/`: JSON schemas for serialized contracts.
- `src/hocrsyngen/data/synthetic/`: governed packaged fonts and Hebrew text corpus.
- `src/hocrsyngen/data/contracts/`: packaged downstream contract fixtures.
- `tests/`: CLI, generation, validation, installation, and package-resource tests.
- `docs/`: architecture, scope, specs, roadmap, research, testing, and decisions.

## Critical File Map

- `src/hocrsyngen/cli.py`: public CLI commands and machine-readable reports.
- `src/hocrsyngen/generator.py`: deterministic rendering, templates, richer template catalog metadata, degradation, font/text selection.
- `src/hocrsyngen/manifest.py`: manifest dataclasses and constants.
- `src/hocrsyngen/rendering_coverage.py`: opt-in rendering coverage report builder and sidecar writer.
- `src/hocrsyngen/wet_run.py`: S8b deterministic wet-test smoke run artifact writer outside manifest v1.
- `src/hocrsyngen/wet_gallery.py`: S8d static HTML gallery builder for existing wet-test runs outside manifest v1.
- `src/hocrsyngen/wet_analysis.py`: S8e deterministic wet-test warning metrics over existing wet-test runs outside manifest v1.
- `src/hocrsyngen/wet_review.py`: S8f human review worksheet template generator and worksheet validator over existing wet-test runs outside manifest v1.
- `src/hocrsyngen/validation.py`: batch validation, schema validation, asset integrity checks.
- `src/hocrsyngen/schemas/generation_manifest.schema.json`: serialized manifest contract.
- `src/hocrsyngen/schemas/rendering_coverage_report.schema.json`: serialized rendering coverage report contract.
- `src/hocrsyngen/schemas/template_catalog.schema.json`: serialized `template_catalog.v2` contract.
- `src/hocrsyngen/data/contracts/generation_manifest_v1/fixture-batch/`: downstream integration fixture.
- `src/hocrsyngen/data/synthetic/fonts/manifest.yaml`: governed packaged font registry.
- `src/hocrsyngen/data/synthetic/texts/hebrew_lines.txt`: packaged Hebrew text corpus.
- `tests/`: contract, generation, validation, installation, and wheel packaging tests.
- `docs/production_readiness.md`: current readiness state, explicit missing production pieces, high-lift quality work, and external hocrgen dependencies.
- `docs/handwriting_research_acceptance_criteria.md`: S5a handwriting research boundaries, reproducibility, licensing, review, evaluation, and stop/reject gates.
- `docs/allograph_character_prototype_plan.md`: S5b deterministic allograph and character-level prototype boundary, bounded sampling plan, Hebrew cases, evidence plan, and proceed/stop gates.
- `docs/word_line_assembly_prototype_plan.md`: S5c deterministic word and line assembly prototype boundary, spacing/wrapping controls, Hebrew cases, S5b interaction, evidence plan, and proceed/stop gates.
- `docs/learned_generation_packaging_boundary.md`: S5d optional learned-generation packaging boundary for experiments, extras, separate packages, model/data provenance, reproducibility, sidecars, and stop/refuse gates.
- `docs/downstream_realism_acceptance_rubric.md`: S6a downstream realism acceptance categories, calibrated example classes, visual evidence expectations, rejection reasons, and hocrgen/HeOCR release-eligibility boundaries.
- `docs/downstream_utility_measurement_contract.md`: S6b downstream utility measurement contract for real-reference prerequisites, CER/WER boundaries, leakage controls, evidence packets, and hocrgen/HeOCR ownership.
- `docs/synthetic_diversity_domain_shift_metrics.md`: S6c synthetic diversity and domain-shift metrics for candidate-batch summaries, repeated-pattern warnings, synthetic-to-real comparison requirements, leakage boundaries, and downstream ownership.
- `docs/release_cap_handoff_policy.md`: S6d release cap handoff policy for public hocrsyngen metadata, evidence packet ids, downstream cap records, source-composition boundaries, and hocrgen/HeOCR governance ownership.
- `docs/review_evidence_sidecar_contract.md`: S6e review evidence sidecar contract for reviewed sample/page ids, reviewer state, decision categories, reason codes, visual evidence references, S6a category references, S6c warning references, S6d cap decision references, limitations, and downstream governance ownership.
- `docs/candidate_batch_profile_mix_handoff.md`: S6f candidate batch profile and mix handoff contract for requested, generated/observed, reviewed, capped/admitted, and released mix layers, gap reason codes, and downstream ownership boundaries.
- `docs/hocrgen_adapter_handoff_checklist.md`: S6g external hocrgen adapter handoff checklist for installed CLI import, public JSON assertions, manifest id/path retention, template_catalog.v2 joins, S6a-S6f evidence links, failure handling, and downstream governance boundaries.
- `docs/wet_testing_program_plan.md`: S8a developer-owned wet-testing sub-plan for staged code validation, human review, optional LLM triage, evidence artifacts, and regression promotion outside manifest v1 and release governance; S8b adds the first smoke run artifact generator, S8c adds the candidate evidence-run handoff, S8d adds the static gallery, S8e adds deterministic warning metrics, and S8f adds the human review worksheet template and validator.
- `docs/script_abstraction_design.md`: S7a design-only script abstraction boundaries for future RTL-script profiles; preserves Hebrew-first manifest v1, logical-order UTF-8 Hebrew, NFC normalization, RTL metadata, and current validation semantics.
- `docs/roadmap.md`: S6 is complete through S6g, S7a script abstraction design is complete, and S8 is active for wet-testing/generator-quality evidence with S8f as the current implementation slice.

## Public Contracts

- `hocrsyngen templates`
- `template_catalog.v2` via `hocrsyngen templates --format json --catalog-version v2`
- Governed template ids include `printed_letter`, `handwritten_note`,
  `archive_card`, `ledger`, and stronger degradation variants.
- `hocrsyngen contracts`
- `hocrsyngen contracts export`
- `hocrsyngen generate`
- `hocrsyngen validate`
- `hocrsyngen wet-run --profile smoke`
- `hocrsyngen wet-gallery RUN_ROOT --output RUN_ROOT/gallery`
- `hocrsyngen wet-analyze RUN_ROOT --format json`
- `hocrsyngen wet-review-template RUN_ROOT --output RUN_ROOT/review/human_review.csv --format json`
- `hocrsyngen wet-review-validate RUN_ROOT REVIEW_PATH --format json`
- `generation_manifest.json` v1
- `wet_test_run.json` via `hocrsyngen wet-run --profile smoke`, outside manifest v1
- Static `gallery/index.html` via `hocrsyngen wet-gallery`, outside manifest v1
- `wet_analysis_report.v1` via `hocrsyngen wet-analyze`, outside manifest v1 and without a schema
- `wet_review_template.v1` summary plus a CSV or JSON Lines worksheet via `hocrsyngen wet-review-template`, outside manifest v1 and without a schema
- `wet_review_validation.v1` summary via `hocrsyngen wet-review-validate`, outside manifest v1 and without a schema
- Optional `rendering_coverage_report.json` sidecar with report version `rendering_coverage_report.v1`
- Optional downstream review evidence sidecar contract documented as `review_evidence_sidecar.v1`; it is not emitted or validated by `hocrsyngen`
- Optional downstream candidate batch profile/mix contract documented as `candidate_batch_profile_mix.v1`; it is not emitted or validated by `hocrsyngen`
- External downstream adapter checklist documented in `docs/hocrgen_adapter_handoff_checklist.md`; it is not emitted or validated by `hocrsyngen`
- S7a script abstraction is planning-only in `docs/script_abstraction_design.md`; Arabic support, broader validation semantics, and manifest v1 changes are not implemented.
- Packaged contract fixture id `generation_manifest_v1_fixture_batch`

## Non-Goals And Boundaries

- No `hocrgen` import from `hocrsyngen`.
- No baseline network, GPU, LLM, or diffusion dependencies.
- No publication or release governance inside `hocrsyngen`.
